verdict.rationale: Mercury's API/CLI expose transactions, statements (PDF), invoices, categories, and other records that a user could programmatically pull out (mercury-docs-12, mercury-docs-13, mercury-probe-3), giving some data portability, but there is no documented single 'export all my data' feature, no bulk open-format (CSV/JSON) full account export, and no closing/leaving workflow tied to data export. Missing for 10: a dedicated full-account data export tool, confirmation of open/standard formats beyond statement PDFs, and any account-closure/data-portability documentation.
